recipes.name: gitlab-mr-watch
recipes.description: Per-MR watcher. Default triage policy covers act/skip/close/noop — noop breaks the self-reply loop.

recipes.name: gitlab-my-mrs-watch
recipes.display_name: GitLab — watch ALL my MRs for review feedback
recipes.description: Auto-monitor every open MR you authored across all GitLab projects via Todos API. No per-MR setup.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: mantis-bug-fix
recipes.display_name: Mantis — fix one bug by id
recipes.description: Manual one-shot fix for a single Mantis bug; press Fire when ready.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: mantis-bug-watch
recipes.description: Watch Mantis filter with source + keyword + resolution=open filters.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: mantis-bug-fix-batch
recipes.display_name: Mantis — fix many bugs by id list
recipes.description: Paste comma-separated bug ids → one mantis-bug-fix-and-mr pipeline per id. Uses inline source — no connector round-trip.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: gitlab-mr-author-watch
recipes.display_name: GitLab MR auto-fix (all MRs I authored)
recipes.description: Filter watch for my open MRs → mr-review-fix when comments change.
recipes.author: forge

recipes.name: gitlab-mr-reviewer-watch
recipes.display_name: GitLab MR pre-review (MRs assigned to me to review)
recipes.description: Filter watch via search_mrs(reviewer_username) — accurately matches MRs awaiting MY review. Each new assignment → mr-pre-review pipeline.
recipes.author: forge

pipelines.name: mr-pre-review
pipelines.description: Analyze + post pre-review comment + open Forge chat session.

pipelines.description: Two-agent conversation: architect designs, implementer codes. Demo template.
